# schemas

- [Decision Schema][sokf:schema-decision] - One architectural decision.
- [Issue Schema][sokf:schema-issue] - An issue tracked through its lifecycle.
- [Overview Schema][sokf:schema-overview] - An overview that materializes other documents.
- [Readme Schema][sokf:schema-readme] - The repository readme.
- [Requirement Schema][sokf:schema-requirement] - User stories with EARS criteria.
